analysis.title: GS Blekos - Marketcolour + Webcast on Midterms Europe Strategy Bayer Zalando Gecina (dg) Heidelberg 4 Nov 2026
key_insights: US equities closed mostly higher Tuesday: SPX +36 bps to 7,568, NDX +68 bps to 28,180 (Semis up about 2.5%), RTY +23 bps to 2,812. Tech +131 bps, Materials -193 bps, Staples -176 bps.
The GS Data Centers basket (GSTMTDAT) rose 3.70% and the AI Basket (GSTMTAIP) rose 2.78%, both outperforming.
In Europe, EU Miners (GSXEMINE) fell 2.8% with copper at an 11-week low, and EU Big Oils (GSXEBOIE) fell 1.2% alongside Brent.

GS hosts two midterm webcasts: a first take at 13.00 UKT and 'Views from D.C. and the Trading Floor' at 15.15 UKT. In a Democratic sweep scenario, its favorite long basket is Affordable Care Act Beneficiaries (GSHLCACA).
The GS desk sees a more balanced two-way flow in Tech. Some of the ongoing Semis/AI supply was met with select buy tickets, unlike the prior several sessions when supply met almost no defense.
Meta and Oracle both traded well after recent capital raises. GS describes a 'paper-rich' environment concentrated in AI and calls it important that the market absorbed large issuance.
GS raised STOXX 600 EPS growth forecasts to 18% for 2026 and 7% for 2027, and introduced a 2028 forecast of 5%. Financials and Commodities contribute strongly.

Hyperscalers have issued $271 billion of debt this year, above GS's full-year 2026 forecast of $250 billion. GS estimates $657 billion of global AI-related syndicated debt issuance year to date through November 2.

Bayer: Buy, PT raised to EUR66 from EUR63.5 (30% upside). The thesis rests on a potentially imminent court ruling on the glyphosate settlement and on Pharma growth that GS thinks the market under-appreciates.

Gecina: downgraded to Neutral, PT cut to EUR72.6 from EUR80.4. 2026-30E EPS changes by -8% to 0% on longer lead times to let pipeline projects, slightly lower rental reversion, and removal of share buyback assumptions.

Heidelberg Materials: Q3 sales and recurring EBIT were about 3% above visible alpha consensus, with positive price/cost and positive volumes for a second consecutive quarter. Europe was the highlight, North America in line, and FY guidance was reiterated, which GS says is a relief after CRH and Amrize cut or cautioned.
Zalando: Buy, PT EUR44 (60% upside, 10x FY27 NOPAT, 12.6% FCF yield). 3Q26 3P and Retail Media both grew 17.8% y/y, and new customers signed for ZEOS fulfillment and Scayle.

US earnings: ANET +6% on growth accelerating to +59% y/y in 3Q. AMD +7%, better than feared on revenue and gross margin. PCOR +13% on 3Q revenue of $402mn (+19% y/y vs guide of $382-384mn). BKNG -7% after hours on guidance for a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights.

Gecina cut from Buy to Neutral with PT lowered from EUR80.4. Longer letting lead times, lower rental reversion and no buyback assumed.
Zalando: 60% upside, 10x FY27 NOPAT, 12.6% FCF yield. 3P and Retail Media grew 17.8% y/y in 3Q26.
Stock +6% on 3Q growth accelerating to +59% y/y, the highest since IPO.
Stock +7%, better than feared on revenue and gross margins, especially after Intel last week.
Stock +13% on a 3Q beat: revenue $402mn (+19% y/y) vs guide of $382-384mn, and cRPO +29% y/y.
Stock -7% after hours on guidance for a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights.

sector_views.rationale: In a Democratic sweep scenario, GS's favorite long is the ACA Beneficiaries basket (GSHLCACA).
Both contribute strongly to the upgraded STOXX 600 EPS forecasts.
Heidelberg Q3 beat and reiterated guidance contrast with more cautious statements and downgraded guidance from CRH and Amrize.

earnings_insights: Heidelberg Materials Q3 (reported): sales and recurring EBIT about 3% above visible alpha consensus. Price/cost positive and volumes positive for a second consecutive quarter. FY guidance reiterated.
Zalando 3Q26 (reported): 3P and Retail Media businesses both grew 17.8% y/y.
Arista (ANET) 3Q (reported): y/y growth accelerated to +59%, the highest since IPO.
AMD (reported): revenue and gross margins better than feared. No figures given.

Procore (PCOR) 3Q (reported): revenue $402mn, +19% y/y, vs company guide of $382-384mn (+13.3% y/y) and +16% y/y last quarter. Includes 2 points of growth from the DroneDeploy acquisition. cRPO +29% y/y vs +22% last quarter.
Booking Holdings (BKNG) (reported): guided to a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights. Stock -7% after hours.
GS STOXX 600 EPS growth forecasts (GS estimate): 18% for 2026, 7% for 2027, 5% for 2028.
